question: Which countries emit the most today?
summary: Emissions are highly concentrated. China emits 12,289 Mt, or 31.8% of the global total. United States is second at 4,904 Mt (12.7%) and India third at 3,193 Mt (8.3%). Together these three emit about 53% of world CO2. The top 10 countries produce 68.9%, so action by a small group of countries has an outsized effect on global totals.
